name: sma_crossover_banknifty_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On BANKNIFTY, large institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms working directional orders create persistent micro-trends visible as SMA alignment across 3-min, 15-min, and 60-min windows. When all three align bullishly, the order flow is sustained at multiple timescales — not just a spike but continuous demand absorption. At 5-second resolution, these trends produce shallow 10-15 spot point pullbacks every 30-60 seconds as retail scalpers take quick profits, but the institutional flow immediately absorbs the dip. We enter on these micro-pullbacks (price touching the 3-min SMA while 15-min and 60-min SMAs are still aligned below) and ride the next 20-30 spot point push as the flow reasserts. This works on BANKNIFTY specifically because its 12-stock composition means a single large FII order in HDFC Bank or ICICI can move the entire index, creating cleaner trends than NIFTY's 50-stock diversification.

indicators.name: sma_36
indicators.purpose: 3-minute micro-trend direction. Original used SMA(10) on 1-min bars = 10-minute view, but that's too slow for 30-60s holds. At 3 minutes we capture the fast micro-trend that aligns with our hold time — if the 3-min trend is up and we enter a pullback to this SMA, we have 30-60s of expected continuation.

indicators.name: sma_180
indicators.purpose: 15-minute session trend filter. Original used SMA(29) on 1-min = 29-min view. Shortened to 15-min because this is a CONTEXT indicator, not a trade trigger. We need to know the session direction, and 15 minutes is enough to establish whether institutional flow is net-long or net-short for the current hour.

indicators.name: sma_720
indicators.purpose: 60-minute session anchor. Original used SMA(100) on 1-min = ~1.5 hour view. Reduced to 60 minutes because we need the first-hour direction as a regime filter. If the 60-min SMA is below price after the first hour, the session is likely trending up. This prevents taking long pullback trades in a session that's drifting lower. Requires 60 min warmup — first trade possible ~10:20 IST.

conditions: close > sma_36 AND sma_36 > sma_180 AND sma_180 > sma_720
VIX < 25 (avoid chaotic regime where trends break)
buy_ce.confirmation: Bar closes above sma_36 after touching it (bounce confirmation)

conditions: close < sma_36 AND sma_36 < sma_180 AND sma_180 < sma_720
close within 0.03% of sma_36 from below
buy_pe.confirmation: Bar closes below sma_36 after touching it from below

exit.stop_rationale: A micro-pullback in a BANKNIFTY trend typically retraces 10-15 spot points (~5-7 ATM option points). If drawdown exceeds 8 spot points (4 option points), the micro-trend has likely broken and the 3-min SMA will cross below — thesis invalidated. 4 points also limits loss to roughly one lot's brokerage cost.
exit.target_rationale: Successful micro-pullback recoveries in trending BANKNIFTY move 20-30 spot points over 30-60 seconds (10-15 ATM option points). Target of 7 captures ~50% of the expected move, giving a 1:1.75 risk-reward. Conservative because we want high win rate on trend-following, not large individual payoffs.

filters.vix_filter: VIX < 25 — high VIX breaks trend persistence as volatility spikes cause random reversals
filters.time_filter: No trades before 10:20 (need 60-min warmup for sma_720) or after 15:15 (avoid expiry-day gamma effects)
filters.trend_filter: embedded in entry (triple SMA alignment IS the trend filter)
filters.spread_filter: skip if ATM option bid-ask > 3 points

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — other trend-following algos compete for the same pullback entries

adaptation_notes: Original used SMA(10/29/100) on 1-min bars giving 10/29/100-minute horizons. Blindly scaling 12x would give SMA(120/348/1200) = identical views but we're holding 30-60s not 5-20min. Instead compressed to SMA(36/180/720) = 3/15/60-minute views to match our hold time. The 3-min SMA is the trade trigger (pullback entry), while 15-min and 60-min are context filters. Added pullback-touch entry condition because the original's 'close > SMA10' fires continuously during trends — at 5s bars we'd overtrade. The pullback-touch requirement creates discrete entry points. Stop widened from original's implied ~50pt BankNifty (~25 option pts) to 4 option points because our hold is 10x shorter. Time stop at 60s vs original 20min because if the pullback doesn't resolve in 60s, the micro-trend may have shifted.
weaknesses: Late session start (~10:20) due to 60-min SMA warmup misses early morning momentum
Triple alignment is a lagging signal — by the time all 3 SMAs align, the strongest part of the move may be over
On range-bound days, SMAs flatten and generate false alignment signals near the crossover zones
BANKNIFTY expiry days (weekly Thursday) have gamma-driven moves that break trend patterns
